_README: Config for YOUR REAL dataset. Search this file for PLACEHOLDER and replace every value marked so. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. Values that still start with '<' are rejected with a clear error, so nothing runs on unfilled settings.
name: real_dataset
_PLACEHOLDER_path: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): path to your file, relative to the project root. Put the file in data/real/.
_PLACEHOLDER_delimiter: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): ',' for CSV, ';' for European Excel exports, '\t' for TSV.
_PLACEHOLDER_column_map: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): left = internal name (do not change), right = the EXACT header in your file. Delete lines for columns you do not have (timestamp and soil_moisture are required). To use your own labels, add "target_irrigation_needed": "<your 0/1 column>" and optionally "target_irrigation_mm": "<your depth column>".

column_map.field_id: <your field / plot / node id column - delete if the file has one field>

_PLACEHOLDER_timestamp: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): strftime format of your dates, e.g. "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M" or "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"; null = auto-detect. Set dayfirst=true for 31/12/2024 style dates. timestamp_offset_hours is ADDED to reach field-local time (UTC data in India: 5.5).
_PLACEHOLDER_units: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): soil_moisture = percent | fraction | raw (raw needs soil_raw_calibration below); temperature = celsius | fahrenheit | kelvin; rainfall = mm | inch; rainfall_mode = interval (rain since previous row) | cumulative (running total, e.g. a rain-gauge counter).
_PLACEHOLDER_soil_raw_calibration: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): only used when units.soil_moisture = raw. Raw sensor value in dry air / in saturated soil and the % VWC they correspond to (measure these for YOUR probe).
_PLACEHOLDER_fields: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): agronomic details. crop_type: cotton|groundnut|maize|onion|potato|tomato|wheat. soil_type: sandy|sandy_loam|loam|clay_loam|clay. irrigation_method: drip|sprinkler|furrow. planting_date: YYYY-MM-DD. latitude: decimal degrees. 'defaults' apply to every field; 'per_field' overrides them for a field id as it appears in your file (delete per_field if you have one field).
_PLACEHOLDER_labels: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): "derive" computes FAO-56 labels from your observations (works without labels, but the rule baseline then partly grades itself). "columns" uses your own labels - add target_irrigation_needed to column_map. Real agronomist/stress labels give the most honest evaluation.
_PLACEHOLDER_drop_columns: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): columns to ignore completely (e.g. IDs, comments).
_PLACEHOLDER_extra: PLACEHOLDER(real-dataset): free-form settings you read in irrigation_advisor/data/dataset_hooks.py via config.extra.
